content.value: À chamber of constant volume of 0.6m³ contains 3.5kg of gas at 22°C having 15 Cp = 1.87 ki/kgk and Cv=1.50 kj/kgk. The heat is given to the gas until the temperature becomes 100°C. Determine (i) the molecular mass and gas constant of the gas, (ii) the work done, (iii) heat transfer, and (iv) change in internal energy.
